outcome: Maternal outcomes (cesarean delivery rates, hypertensive disorders, postpartum hemorrhage)
Neonatal outcomes (perinatal mortality, preterm birth, APGAR scores, NICU admissions)
cohort: 10,603 twin pregnancies delivered between 2000 and 2015 in Hessen, Germany
finding: Non-optimal weekly maternal weight gain was strongly associated with both maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes in twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Low and high gestational weight gain were both associated with higher rates of cesarean deliveries.
